pages.text: The world is full of places to explore: nearly four hundred kinds of structure from twenty mods, on top of vanilla's. $(bold)Loot chests are your own$() (Lootr): everyone who opens one gets their own loot, so nobody gets beaten to it.

$(#b9a98a)Mod - What it adds$()$(br)$(bold)$(bold)When Dungeons Arise$()$() - Huge dungeons: fortresses, temples, ships, palaces and sky fortresses, well guarded and well stocked$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Dungeons and Taverns$()$() - Taverns in every wood, firewatch towers, ruined settlements, illager camps and manors, combat shrines, and Nether and End castles$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Towns and Towers$()$() - Villages and pillager outposts for nearly every biome$(br)$(bold)$(bold)YUNG's$()$() - Better dungeons, mineshafts, strongholds, desert and jungle temples, ocean monuments, witch huts and Nether fortresses

$(bold)$(bold)Create: Structures Arise$() and $(bold)Let The Adventure Begin$()$() - Create-themed ruins, airships, train stations, mines, windmills and an oil rig$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Structory$() and $(bold)Structory: Towers$()$() - Ruins, camps, graveyards and manors, and towers and outposts$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Towers of the Wild$()$() - Tall towers in every biome, with a waystone on top$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Terralith$()$() - Fortified villages, mage towers, desert outposts and underground ruins$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Illager Invasion$()$() - Forts, towers, huts and a labyrinth for its new illagers

$(bold)$(bold)Friends & Foes$()$() - The iceologer's cabin, the illusioner's shack and training grounds, and the citadel$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Ice and Fire$()$() - Dragon caves and roosts$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Nullscape$()$() - A dragon's skeleton and the Rift, in the End$(br2)Structures with many variants (a village for every biome, a mineshaft for every wood) share one card that lists its kinds.
